subject: Audit pack: contractor JIT provisioning, SCIM delta logs & SAML assertion tie-out
messages:
From: Amira Hassan <security@fintrust.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: Ben Li <procurement@fintrust.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2/SIG intake: contractor JIT provisioning + SCIM/SAML deliverables

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the quick sync earlier. As part of FinTrust's upcoming SIG assessment (control set: IAM + Access Management), our auditor team has the following ask list for Redwood. We'd like to receive a packaged deliverable by 2026-03-10 if possible. Please confirm feasibility and an owner for each item below: 

1) Service account inventory (last 12 months) with owner, purpose, and justification for non-human use.
2) Justification artifacts for any long-lived service accounts; list of those that have been moved to ephemeral/JIT patterns.
3) SCIM delta stream for user provisioning/deprovisioning covering 2026-01-01 -> 2026-02-28 (we need all Add/Update/Remove events).
4) Sample SAML assertions for successful logins (three samples across date ranges and one failed assertion) with timestamps and audience values.
5) RBAC role mapping: a matrix showing role -> permissions -> sample principal count.
6) Audit extract: admin console actions that granted or revoked admin privileges in the last 90 days.
7) Short (1 page) narrative describing how contractors are onboarded/offboarded, including PR/approval gates and JIT access flow.

If you need to redact PII, a redaction template is fine. We will accept staged deliveries (e.g., provide the inventory + narrative first, then logs). Please include contact for legal/procurement questions: Ben Li on cc.

Thanks,
Amira Hassan
Senior InfoSec Manager — FinTrust Capital
[Attachment: SIG checklist (pdf)]

Required outputs and suggested owners/deadlines:
- service_account_inventory.csv (Marcus) — include name, id, owner, creation_date, last_used, justification, is_ephemeral_flag. Draft by 2026-03-05 EOD.
- sa_justifications.md (Marcus) — short rationale for any long-lived accounts and mitigation steps. 2026-03-05 EOD.
- scim_delta_20260101-20260228.jsonl (Engineering logs) — raw delta events; if PII present, provide a redacted copy and a mapping key separately. 2026-03-07
- saml_assertion_samples_202602.zip (Irene + Eng) — three successful and one failed assertion, include date/issuer/audience. 2026-03-07
- role_mapping_matrix.xlsx (Vanessa) — consolidated roles, permissions, and counts. 2026-03-06
- admin_action_extract.csv (Vanessa) — console grant/revoke events last 90 days, include actor and timestamp. 2026-03-06
- contractor_onboarding.md (Irene) — 1 page JIT flow + approval gates + ticketing references. 2026-03-05

Notes: Marcus — for service accounts, check our vault/identity provider CR source (svc-accounts repo) and correlate with runtime usage metrics. Vanessa — coordinate anonymized role counts for FinTrust (they expect sample principal counts, not full user lists).

Please reply inline with confirmations and any blockers.

Thanks,
Irene

From: Amira Hassan <security@fintrust.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: Ben Li <procurement@fintrust.com>, audit-ops@fintrust.com
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2/SIG intake: contractor JIT provisioning + SCIM/SAML deliverables

Irene/Marcus — thanks, that timeline looks good. A few clarifications from the audit team:
- Hashed principal identifiers are acceptable provided you supply a mapping file to the auditor under NDA (we can accept an encrypted mapping via secure upload).
- For the service account inventory, please flag any accounts that have owner-less status or shared keys.
- SCIM delta: we require the event type (Add/Update/Remove), timestamp, and the target external_id — hashed is fine.
- SAML assertions: include the full Issuer and AssertionConsumerService URL; redaction of NameID is OK.

Also, please include a short signed attestation (PDF) from Redwood security that the exported logs are complete for the requested window. If you can provide a staged delivery (inventory + narrative by 2026-03-05 and logs by 2026-03-07), that will work.

Ben — we're fine to proceed on FinTrust side; procurement will track the NDA for the mapping file once we receive the inventory.

Thanks again — looking forward to the packet.

Amira Hassan
Senior InfoSec Manager — FinTrust Capital
[Attachment: auditors_constraints.txt]
